run_fpga_resnet_validation: run a ResNet-50 model on FPGA hardware using posit number representation and validate accuracy
create_FpgaNN_wrapper: create a FpgaNN wrapper class that converts inputs to posit format and runs forward passes on FPGA
build_get_fpga_mods: build a function that extracts and names all ResNet-50 modules for FPGA parameter fusion
test_fpga_resnet_forward: test the FpgaNN forward method to convert input to posit, run FPGA inference, and return float output
review_fuse_resnet_params: review the fpga_resnet fuse_resnet_params call that transfers CPU model weights to the FPGA model
